title: Lighter lists Robinhood-issued ANT token, excluding US and some other markets
digest:
Lighter listed Robinhood-issued debt token ANT on 2026-11-20, excluding US investors and those in several other markets. 

ANT is not direct Anthropic equity but a debt instrument tied to Robinhood’s operations, per Lighter’s listing announcement. The exclusion reflects compliance with US and international regulatory constraints on Anthropic-related assets, as noted by The Defiant. 

The move limits market access to non-US participants, with Lighter specifying that the token’s trading conditions and eligibility criteria remain subject to ongoing regulatory reviews.
